definition: a feeling of being angry for a long time because someone treated you badly
sentence: I still feel some {resentment} about how they fired me.
translation: Я до сих пор немного обижен на то, как меня уволили.

definition: not easy to find, existing in small amounts
sentence: Parking is {scarce} around the stadium on match days.
translation: В дни матчей возле стадиона почти негде припарковаться.

definition: having more than one possible meaning, not clear
sentence: His message was so {ambiguous} that I didn't know if he was coming.
translation: Его сообщение было таким двусмысленным, что я не понял, придёт ли он.

definition: very quickly and without any sign that it was coming
sentence: The bus stopped so {abruptly} that I dropped my coffee.
translation: Автобус затормозил так резко, что я уронил кофе.

definition: to do what you promised or what was expected
sentence: The hotel didn't {fulfil} any of its promises about the pool.
translation: Отель не выполнил ни одного обещания насчёт бассейна.
